subject: Interim continuity endorsement request and evidence handoff - Larimar
messages:
From: Jessica Sanchez <jessica.sanchez@larimar.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@larimar.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request for interim continuity endorsement and evidence (post-report gap)

Hi Irene / Laura,

Hope you’re both well. Larimar is moving through our security procurement review and BrightPath (our external assessor) asked us to obtain an interim continuity endorsement that covers the period after Redwood’s last SOC 2 Type II report period end (2026-12-31) through 2027-03-31. For clarity, BrightPath will accept either a short management assertion (signed) that: 1) confirms no material control changes affecting the scope occurred in the post-report window, and 2) provides the limited supporting evidence inventory (redacted SOC 2, control-change log, and pointer to KMS/key rotation evidence).

Our procurement cadence is tight — we need the endorsement and the evidence handoff by end-of-day 2027-03-18 to keep the deal timeline. Can Redwood provide:
- A one-page management continuity endorsement (signed by a Redwood exec or compliance lead) covering 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31
- A redacted copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (or pointer to an existing redacted copy)
- A short control-change log for Jan–Mar 2027 and any relevant tickets/PRs

If it helps, BrightPath can accept a DocuSign-signed PDF. Please let me know the expected delivery and any gaps we should be aware of. We can set a 15–20 minute call if needed.

Thanks — Jessica

Jessica Sanchez
Senior Vendor Security Manager
Larimar Health Solutions
jessica.sanchez@larimar.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: procurement_form_larimar.pdf (procurement/PO form)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Sanchez <jessica.sanchez@larimar.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for interim continuity endorsement and evidence (post-report gap)

Hi Jessica — thanks for the clear note and timeline. We can support this request. A few quick clarifying items so we provide exactly what BrightPath needs:

1) Scope window: you asked to cover 2027-01-01 through 2027-03-31. Confirmed? Our SOC 2 report period ended 2026-12-31.
2) Signed attestation: do you require an exec-level signature (VP/Head of Security) or will a Compliance Ops lead signature suffice for procurement?
3) Evidence level: we can supply a redacted SOC 2 PDF, a control-change summary (ticket ids + high-level descriptions), and a KMS rotation statement (dates + rotation checklist). Will BrightPath need raw logs or just the summarized pointers?

I’ve looped in Karthik (security engineering) and Laura (Comms/Contracts) so we can assemble the package quickly. If procurement needs DocuSign, we can route the attestation through our DocuSign template and share the signed PDF. Proposed timeline from our side: confirmation today, mezzanine draft attestation by 2027-03-14, final signed PDF by 2027-03-17. Does that work for you?

If you’d like, we can do a 15-minute sync today at 2pm PT — say yes/no and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,

Irene Choi
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Sanchez <jessica.sanchez@larimar.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for interim continuity endorsement and evidence (post-report gap)

Jessica — following up on Irene’s plan. We’ve prepared the redacted report and the control-change log for Jan–Mar 2027; items included:
- SOC2_Redwood_TypeII_20261231_redacted.pdf (redactions: customer names, IPs)
- control_change_log_202701-202703.xlsx (columns: ticket, owner, date, summary, impact)
- KMS rotation summary (dates + responsible team) — included as pointers in the control_change_log spreadsheet

I initiated a DocuSign envelope for the one-page management continuity endorsement (template: "Interim Continuity Endorsement — Redwood"). Expect a signed PDF within 48 hrs after review. I also uploaded the redacted report and control log to the drive folder and attached the procurement form you sent.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-bridge-evidence
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/status/0A1B2C3D

If BrightPath needs anything more granular (e.g., specific ticket diffs or change approvals), let us know and Karthik can provide the additional context.

Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_Redwood_TypeII_20261231_redacted.pdf; control_change_log_202701-202703.xlsx

From: Jessica Sanchez <jessica.sanchez@larimar.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audit Team <audits@brightpathcpa.com>, procurement <procurement@larimar.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for interim continuity endorsement and evidence (post-report gap)

Thanks — this is perfect and on the timeline we needed. We received the drive upload and the DocuSign envelope, and procurement confirms the form is complete. BrightPath will review the redacted report and the control log; if they need more than the summary pointers they’ll reach out directly to Karthik (cc’d).

For our records, can you confirm the signed endorsement will state explicitly that: 1) no material control changes affecting SOC 2 in-scope systems occurred between 2027-01-01 and 2027-03-31, and 2) the attached evidence inventory is accurate and complete to Redwood’s knowledge as of the signature date? If so, we’ll mark the procurement checklist as satisfied.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,

Jessica

Attachment: procurement_form_larimar.pdf (updated with redwood references)
